project_title: Aegis OS - Personal AI Command Center PWA

font_rules: Use tabular-nums class on all countdowns, clocks, step counts, score history, and metrics to prevent layout jitter
Headings should use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter
Overlines and badges should be uppercase, text-xs, with tracking-[0.2em]
Do NOT use Space Grotesk (Forbidden font for dashboards)

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density Command Center)
layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Tight 16px to 24px gap with inner padding p-5 or p-6 to eliminate text edge collisions
layout_and_spacing.border_style: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10) with inset top edge highlight
layout_and_spacing.no_backdrop_blur_rule: STRICT REQUIREMENT: NO backdrop-blur filters. Use solid #0D111A or 95% opacity #06080E surfaces for performance and sharp sub-50ms rendering.

modules.name: Global Header & Command Bar
features: Aegis OS branding badge with live status dot (green online / amber exam)
Exam/Emergency Mode toggle switch (shifts top radial glow and accent borders from Cyan to Amber/Crimson)
Next-class live countdown pill (JetBrains Mono tabular-nums)
Global Notification bell with popover drawer
Ctrl+K Command Palette trigger (Raycast style modal search with keybindings and instant action execution)

modules.name: Home Bento Dashboard
features: User Greeting + ZERO AI ONLINE pulsing status indicator badge
4 High-Density KPI Cards: High-priority tasks counter, Next class countdown timer, Step ring percentage, Coding streak day count
Free-Slot Optimizer interactive timeline view
Hardware-styled Pomodoro Timer with 20-20-20 eye rest alerts & sound toggle

modules.name: Timetable & Schedule Hub
features: Drag-and-drop Timetable OCR Image/File uploader with AI parse simulation
Interactive weekly color-coded class grid
15-minute prior class notification alerts and location tags

modules.name: Zero AI Assistant
features: Full-page chat command view with conversational history
Slide-over HUD drawer accessible from anywhere via floating button or shortcut
Real-time audio voice waveform visualizer during speech
One-click executable Action Cards (e.g., 'Reschedule Lab', 'Draft Email', 'Lock Focus Mode')

modules.name: Academics & Knowledge Vault
features: Syllabus Modules 1-6 progress tracker with completion bars
Markdown Lab Notes editor & view
10-MCQ Interactive Quiz runner with live countdown timer, auto-grading, and instant rationale
Score history performance chart (Recharts bar/line chart)

modules.name: Coding & ML Hub
features: GitHub & LeetCode activity heatmap grid
DSA Spaced Repetition Vault with confidence score tagging
Project Kanban board (Backlog, In Progress, Review, Shipped)
ML Experiment tracking table with metrics bar chart comparison

modules.name: Health & Energy Metrics
features: Circular Step Ring SVG indicator
Sleep vs. Deep Work dual-axis balance chart
Hydration intake and Caffeine dosage tracker with quick-add buttons

modules.name: Webhooks & YouTube Pipeline Board
features: Webhooks control grid with live terminal log console (Monospace retro stream)
YouTube video processing pipeline Kanban board (Idea -> Script -> Render -> Published)

modules.name: Settings & PWA Management
features: Gemini API key configuration form
Google Fit client ID integration fields
Export / Import offline JSON state backup tool
PWA offline status indicator & service worker cache manager

motion_and_microinteractions.hover_effects: Card border shifts to accent tint (e.g., cyan-500/40), subtle translateY(-1px)
motion_and_microinteractions.pulsing_dots: Live status indicators use pinging outer ring with crisp solid inner dot
motion_and_microinteractions.scrollbars: Custom 4px thin dark scrollbar with background #06080E and thumb #1E293B

image_urls.description: Futuristic chamber with glowing energy beam for Zero AI core identity visual
Control desk with multiple screens for Aegis OS background banner

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement high-density bento cards with strict 1px border-white/10 and top inset shadow
Never apply backdrop-blur or heavy transparent overlays; use solid dark cards (#0D111A)
Ensure all metric counters, clocks, and timers render with JetBrains Mono tabular-nums
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes matching the design_guidelines.json specification
Support offline persistence via localStorage / IndexedDB for all 7 modules
Include Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut listener for global command palette trigger
